items.question: Which WNBA teams has Celeste Taylor played for?
items.answer: Celeste Taylor has played for the Phoenix Mercury, Connecticut Sun and Indiana Fever.

items.question: How did Celeste Taylor play as a WNBA rookie?
items.answer: In 2024, Celeste Taylor played 22 regular-season games: 15 for the Phoenix Mercury, where she averaged 3.5 points, 1.8 rebounds and 1.8 assists, plus 5 for Indiana and 2 for Connecticut.

items.question: Where did Celeste Taylor play college basketball?
items.answer: Celeste Taylor played at Texas, transferred to Duke, and finished with a fifth season at Ohio State.

items.question: Was Celeste Taylor Defensive Player of the Year?
items.answer: Yes. Celeste Taylor was named ACC Defensive Player of the Year as a senior at Duke.

items.question: When was Celeste Taylor drafted?
items.answer: The Indiana Fever selected Celeste Taylor in the second round, 15th overall, in the 2024 WNBA Draft.

items.question: Did Celeste Taylor play in Australia?
items.answer: Yes. Celeste Taylor signed with the Sydney Flames for the 2024-25 WNBL season.

items.question: How old is Celeste Taylor?
items.answer: Celeste Taylor was born June 20, 2001, in Queens, New York.

items.question: How tall is Celeste Taylor?
items.answer: Basketball-Reference lists Celeste Taylor at 5 feet 11 inches. Her position is guard.
